mapper.select: WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
WHERE p.plan_id = #{planId}

SELECT COUNT(defect_id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN defect_state = 0 OR defect_state = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN defect_state = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verify_count, SUM(CASE WHEN defect_state = 2 OR defect_state = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count FROM sys_defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(up.user_id) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN upr.role_id = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS admin_count, SUM(CASE WHEN upr.role_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS development_count, SUM(CASE WHEN upr.role_id = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_count, SUM(CASE WHEN upr.role_id = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_count FROM sys_user_project up LEFT JOIN sys_user_project_role upr ON up.user_project_id = upr.user_project_id WHERE up.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS defect_count,
date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m') AS defect_time,
date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS defect_time,
defect_state FROM sys_defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY defect_time, defect_state ORDER BY defect_time, defect_state

SELECT COUNT(*) AS defect_count,
FORMATDATETIME(update_time, 'yyyy-MM') AS defect_time,
FORMATDATETIME(update_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS defect_time,
defect_state FROM sys_defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY defect_time, defect_state ORDER BY defect_time, defect_state

SELECT s.*, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM ( SELECT CAST(defect_id AS CHAR(255)) AS id, CONCAT('#', project_num, ' ', defect_name) AS title, 'defect' AS type, CAST(defect_state AS CHAR(255)) AS state, IFNULL(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT CAST(case_id AS CHAR(255)) AS id, case_name AS title, 'case' AS type, NULL AS state, IFNULL(update_time, create_time) AS time, (SELECT u2.user_id FROM sys_user u2 WHERE CAST(u2.user_name AS CHAR(255)) = CAST(c.update_by AS CHAR(255)) LIMIT 1) AS update_by_id FROM sys_case c WHERE project_id = #{projectId} UNION SELECT CAST(plan_id AS CHAR(255)) AS id, plan_name AS title, 'plan' AS type, NULL AS state, IFNULL(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_plan WHERE project_id = #{projectId} UNION SELECT CAST(doc_id AS CHAR(255)) AS id, file_url AS title, 'document' AS type, NULL AS state, IFNULL(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_document WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ) s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.update_by_id ORDER BY s.time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s.*, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar FROM ( SELECT CAST(defect_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, CONCAT('#', project_num, ' ', defect_name) AS title, 'defect' AS type, CAST(defect_state AS VARCHAR) AS state, COALESCE(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = '0' UNION SELECT CAST(case_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, case_name AS title, 'case' AS type, NULL AS state, COALESCE(update_time, create_time) AS time, (SELECT u2.user_id FROM sys_user u2 WHERE u2.user_name = c.update_by LIMIT 1) AS update_by_id FROM sys_case c WHERE project_id = #{projectId} UNION SELECT CAST(plan_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, plan_name AS title, 'plan' AS type, NULL AS state, COALESCE(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_plan WHERE project_id = #{projectId} UNION SELECT CAST(doc_id AS VARCHAR) AS id, file_url AS title, 'document' AS type, NULL AS state, COALESCE(update_time, create_time) AS time, update_by_id FROM sys_document WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ) s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.update_by_id ORDER BY s.time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT date_format(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS handle_time, SUM(CASE WHEN plan_item_state = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count FROM sys_plan_item WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY plan_id, handle_time ORDER BY handle_time

SELECT FORMATDATETIME(update_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS handle_time, SUM(CASE WHEN plan_item_state = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass_count FROM sys_plan_item WHERE plan_id = #{planId} GROUP BY plan_id, handle_time ORDER BY handle_time

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, d.defect_total, d.defect_today_count FROM ( SELECT update_by_id, SUM(defect_total) AS defect_total, SUM(defect_today_count) AS defect_today_count FROM ( SELECT l.create_by AS update_by_id, count(DISTINCT l.defect_id) AS defect_total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') THEN l.defect_id ELSE NULL END) AS defect_today_count FROM sys_defect_log l JOIN sys_defect e ON e.defect_id = l.defect_id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY e.project_id, l.create_by UNION SELECT create_by AS update_by_id, 0 AS defect_total, 0 AS defect_today_count FROM sys_project WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ) a GROUP BY update_by_id ) d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON d.update_by_id = u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, d.defect_total, d.defect_today_count FROM ( SELECT l.create_by AS update_by_id, count(DISTINCT l.defect_id) AS defect_total, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN FORMATDATETIME(l.create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') = FORMATDATETIME(NOW(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') THEN l.defect_id ELSE NULL END) AS defect_today_count FROM sys_defect_log l JOIN sys_defect e ON e.defect_id = l.defect_id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY e.project_id, l.create_by ORDER BY defect_total DESC ) d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON d.update_by_id = u.user_id

SELECT u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, d.update_by_id AS user_id, d.create_time, d.defect_today_count FROM ( SELECT e.project_id,
date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS create_time,
date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS create_time,
l.create_by AS update_by_id, count(DISTINCT l.defect_id) AS defect_today_count FROM sys_defect_log l JOIN sys_defect e ON e.defect_id = l.defect_id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY e.project_id, create_time, l.create_by ORDER BY create_time DESC ) d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON d.update_by_id = u.user_id

SELECT u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, d.update_by_id AS user_id, d.create_time, d.defect_today_count FROM ( SELECT e.project_id,
FORMATDATETIME(l.create_time, 'yyyy-MM') AS create_time,
FORMATDATETIME(l.create_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS create_time,
l.create_by AS update_by_id, count(DISTINCT l.defect_id) AS defect_today_count FROM sys_defect_log l JOIN sys_defect e ON e.defect_id = l.defect_id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY e.project_id, create_time, l.create_by ORDER BY create_time DESC ) d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON d.update_by_id = u.user_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oper_channel = 'mcp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mcp_call_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oper_channel = 'api' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS api_call_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(IFNULL(oper_channel, '')) IN ('openai', 'llm', 'ai') THEN 1 WHEN oper_url LIKE '%/ai/%' OR oper_url LIKE '%/cat2ai/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS llm_call_count FROM sys_oper_log WHERE oper_time >= #{weekStart} AND oper_time < #{weekEnd}

SELECT u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, COUNT(DISTINCT l.defect_id) AS metric_count FROM sys_defect_log l JOIN sys_defect e ON e.defect_id = l.defect_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = l.create_by WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.create_time >= #{weekStart} AND l.create_time < #{weekEnd} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar
